title: Template:Countdown/doc
wikitext:
This templated is used to display a countdown to a set date, and if present, also show twitch link. ==Example== {{Countdown |date=February 14, 2023 12:10 {{Abbr/CET}} |stream=suddendeathTV |stream2= |finished= }} ==Code== 
{{Countdown
|date=February 14, 2023 12:10 {{Abbr/CET}}
|stream=suddendeathTV
|stream2=
|finished=
}}
== Use == ;|date= :Set the date with format: Month day, year HH:MM TIMEZONE.
If the date is in the future, the countdown will show.
If the date is in the past, the date will show but without countdown. ;|stream= :(Optional) Add a link to a stream. Use only stream name, not full url. ;|stream2= :(Optional) Add a link to a second stream. Use only stream name, not full url. ;|finished= :(Optional) Set this to "true" to hide the countdown.
